explanation: The article on the Napoleonic Wars opens by saying where they came from: **"The wars originated in political forces arising from the French Revolution (1789–1799) and French Revolutionary Wars (1792–1802) and produced a period of French domination over continental Europe."** Originating in political forces arising from a revolution is enabling and not causing — the sentence names no act of the revolution that set a war going — and the weaker of the two types the source allows is the one written. The same lead lists the Peninsular War among the seven conflicts the Napoleonic Wars are made of, which is why that war is filed under this one rather than linked to it. Probable, for the reason every edge drawn from this source is.
